items.source: When a handler starts asynchronous request handling, the DispatcherServlet exits without invoking postHandle and afterCompletion, as it normally does, since the results of request handling (for example, ModelAndView) are not available in the current thread and handling is not yet complete. In such scenarios, the afterConcurrentHandlingStarted(WebRequest) method is invoked instead allowing implementations to perform tasks such as cleaning up thread bound attributes.
items.translation: 当处理器启动异步请求处理时，DispatcherServlet 会退出，而不会像通常那样调用 postHandle 和 afterCompletion，因为当前线程中不可用请求处理的结果（例如 ModelAndView），且处理尚未完成。在此类场景中，将调用 afterConcurrentHandlingStarted(WebRequest) 方法，允许实现执行诸如清理线程绑定属性之类的任务。

items.source: When asynchronous handling completes, the request is dispatched to the container for further processing. At this stage the DispatcherServlet invokes preHandle, postHandle and afterCompletion as usual.
items.translation: 当异步处理完成后，请求被分派到容器以进行进一步处理。在此阶段，DispatcherServlet 照常调用 `preHandle`、`postHandle` 和 `afterCompletion`。

items.source: Called instead of postHandle and afterCompletion, when the handler started handling the request concurrently.
items.translation: 在处理器并发处理请求时，会调用此方法而不是`postHandle`和`afterCompletion`。
